claim: OPS supports exact same-cell phase-to-target measurement analysis
allowed_wording: same-cell atlas with sparse heterogeneous targeted measurements
disallowed_wording: all reporters measured in every screen

claim: Method choice affects recovery under the intended generalization test
statistical_unit: paired reporter for inference and screen or assay for descriptive summaries
allowed_wording: paired reporter comparisons identify method differences conditional on evaluation setting

claim: Measurement value overlap and recoverability are non-equivalent
allowed_wording: phase-marker overlap is weakly associated with directed recoverability

claim: Exact pairing carries information beyond group and coarse morphology shortcuts
allowed_wording: exact-cell information remains after controls and within-condition residualization
disallowed_wording: all fluorescence state is predictable from phase

claim: Distinct stability amplitude environment and ambiguity constraints limit sufficiency
allowed_wording: constraints are associated with different failure modes
disallowed_wording: each constraint is an independently causal mechanism

claim: Scientific utility requires use-specific measurement decisions
allowed_wording: response-based tiers and downstream-analysis retention provide distinct evidence for intended uses
disallowed_wording: high Pearson alone proves assay replacement

claim: Predictive recovery and retained scientific utility can diverge
allowed_wording: the cohort median utility is a descriptive split and does not enter the tier rules
disallowed_wording: the utility median is a new measurement-sufficiency threshold

claim: Screen context can change recovery and rank evidence within reporter
statistical_unit: directed destination-screen evaluation nested within reporter
allowed_wording: recovery and rank cross the 0.70 gate for a subset of repeated reporters
disallowed_wording: the complete five-gate tier was recalculated for every destination screen
